speaker: jacqueline_field
text: I have bread, and a hard cheese, for the first day. They will keep to the first night if the cloth is clean.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will take them, and thank you once.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Once is the right number. The cheese is the harder of the two I had.

speaker: richard_field
text: The boy. I looked in the box of battered sorts.

speaker: richard_field
text: A capital H, with a chipped foot. No use to any printer. Tell him it has been in Plutarch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will tell him.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: A letter of lead is a strange sweet. He will keep it, if he is the boy you mean.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He is the boy. He keeps oddments. A chipped H will please him more than a clean one.

speaker: richard_field
text: Tell him the foot is chipped, so he does not think I was careless. It is broken, and it is the gift.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will say it has been in Plutarch, and that the foot is chipped, and that you are not sorry.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The pins stay in the paper. They will find a thumb otherwise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The pins are for the house. The book is for her. The H is for him. The bread and the cheese are for Monday.

speaker: richard_field
text: And Holinshed is for the cloth. Thou wilt find him where thou leavest him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mistress Ansell's eye is on the cloth. I will not move it.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Then take the wrapping, and do not bring it back as a story.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have what I meant to carry. I am leaving the one book I must not carry.

speaker: richard_field
text: St James, and a man counting parcels. The cheese is for Monday, not for the Theatre.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The lodging feeds me today. The cheese waits.

speaker: richard_field
text: Tell him it has been in Plutarch. The foot is chipped, and that is the gift.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will tell him it has been in Plutarch.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Bread, and a hard cheese, for the first day. No further than that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The first day. I am not taking the Holinshed, and I am not packing the house.

speaker: richard_field
text: Leave my Holinshed with me while thou'rt gone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It lies under a cloth, and Mistress Ansell has her eye on it.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Then the cheese is yours, and the book is not.
